applicability: T4 v2 and T5 v3 parent content groups; no receipt block means the unchanged entrypoint skips silently.
lesson: Require an explicit receipt-block presence check before treating Markdown guard success as evidence completeness.
reusable_condition: Only when a future registered operation can distinguish absent blocks from mismatching blocks without changing the shared guard.

applicability: T5 v2 rejected; closed for the T5 v3 content group by external runtime tick and delivered-tree immutability.
lesson: Runtime-sensitive positive controls must be generated outside the delivered tree and never mutate manifest-bound fixtures.
reusable_condition: Re-open only for a different parent content group or a newly evidenced failure not covered by T5 v3.
